description: This file contains utility functions for displaying UI components such as form validation and JavaScript code generation for Employee forms within SuiteCRM, a CRM extension. It includes functions to generate JavaScript for form validation and tab selection handling.

methods.name: get_validate_record_js
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to validate employee record form data before submission, including checking required fields and email validation.

methods.name: get_chooser_js
methods.description: Generates JavaScript for handling the display of tabs in the form view.
